decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer builds directly on the firm's existing inkjet machinery knowledge, allowing it to assimilate early results and improve the product.
The software module for numbering extends the firm's current digital printing software and hardware integration expertise, so the firm can readily interpret feedback and enhance it.
The inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces leverages existing coding technology but requires new ink and substrate knowledge, which the firm can develop through R&D or cooperation.
